caption: The drawing depicts an ornate wall clock with a decorative design. At the top, there is a gold-colored eagle with outstretched wings. Below the eagle, the circular clock face features black numerals from 1 to 12 and smaller black numerals marking every five-minute interval. The clock hands are black and the text "L. WATROUS PATENT" is inscribed inside the face. Surrounding the clock face is a gold circular frame with regularly spaced round decorations. Below the clock face, the body of the clock is elongated and bordered with gold and bronze hues, with a narrow painted scene in the middle. The painted scene, in muted brown, green, and gold colors, shows a figure in green and pink with a yellow background and the text "LIBERTY" above the figure’s head. The bottom portion of the clock is another large circle, framed in gold, containing a painted nautical scene with several sailing ships on choppy blue water; the ships display white and red flags. The lower terminus of the clock’s body features intricate gold scrollwork. The drawing is rendered on a beige background, and "JOHN DIETERICH" is written in the bottom left corner.
title: Clock
